programme.title: Andrew Rivers
programme.desc: Andrew's very personal and fun storytelling comedy, combined with his exemplary work ethic has earned him high praise from some of the best comedians in the business. Andrew is a featured writer, actor, and comedian on the TV show “UpLate NW.” Andrew has been featured on NBC, FOX, and the Bob & Tom Radio Show and is a regular opening act for Christopher Titus. Andrew was also featured on the popular Buzzfeed web series “Truth or Drink“, has performed in over 35 states and his new podcast called “Don't Quit Your Night Job” was featured in the Seattle Times.

programme.title: Phil Kopczynski
programme.desc: Phil Kopczynski is a reluctant nice guy and father who just wants to occasionally play in the wilderness and regularly make city-dwellers laugh.

programme.title: Tom Mabe
programme.desc: Tom has been profiled in People magazine, called "gut-busting hilarious" by The New York Times, and given a perfect 4-star rating by the New York Post. He's been featured on radio shows from Hollywood to Dollywood, including "Bob&Tom", Johnboy & Billy "BillHandel" and "Drew&Mike". Chances are you also know Tom as the star of CMT's hit comedy series, "Mabe in America", or have watched one of his popular viral videos. With more than 50-million views on YouTube, Tom is one of the most downloaded people on the planet. People love Tom's stories about coping with life's challenges, ranging from a child with a microscopic attention span to a family vacation in a minivan that takes a wrong turn. His original songs, stories, and videos make for a night out you will remember for years.

programme.title: Marty Simpson
programme.desc: Former high school football coach and drama teacher, Marty Simpson jokes about how to punish teenagers, getting rid of 500 bats in his attic, and how his love language is sarcasm.

programme.title: Rob Little: Ado-Rob-Ble
programme.desc: Rob Little's outlook on life can be summed up in two words: Pure Optimism. In a recent interview he revealed, "In elementary school, kids would always pull food away from me at lunchtime saying mean, hurtful things like " 'Let go of my sandwich!'"

programme.title: Josh Fonokalafi
programme.desc: Joshua T Fonokalafi is a Utah based comedian from the mean streets of Ogden, Utahs own Compton. Raised in the Northwest and the son of an Islander immigrant, Joshua tells of his hardships growing up as one of the biggest minorities in the country. Joshua was most recently featured at the Idaho Laugh Fest and is preparing to film his very own comedy special with VidAngel. He's acted in Jackie and Ryan with Katherine Heigl, and in Certain Woman with Laura Dern and Kristen Stewart. Joshua's quick wit and humor will give you an amazing abdominal workout.

programme.title: Orlando Baxter
programme.desc: Orlando Baxter's fresh perspective and unique relatability makes this former high school teacher a fan favorite all over the world. In 2016, Orlando made his late night TV debut on the Conan show on TBS, and since then he's appeared on the television shows "Comedy Up Late" in Australia, B.E.T.'s "50 Central" and Laff Mobb's Laff Track on Tru TV.

programme.title: Dry Bar Comedy
programme.desc: In Bible School Dropout, Dennis Gaxiola returns to the stage with fresh stories from faith, fatherhood, and his realization that God called him to make others laugh with his Bible knowledge... just not as a Bible school graduate.

programme.title: Maureen Langan
programme.desc: Maureen Langan has a wake up call ringing for the young, hot, rich or famous. Luckily for them, she comes with subtitles.

programme.title: Brian Moote
programme.desc: Brian Moote started performing stand up in 2005 while he was working as a teacher in the Seattle School District. He then went to graduate school to get a masters degree in social work because who doesn't love crippling debt? I mean, this is America. After graduating he moved to LA and now tours the country telling jokes. He has made TV appearances on the USA Network's "Characters Welcome," Nickelodeon's "Nickmom's Nite Out," MTV's "Money from Strangers" and AXS TV's "Gotham Live." You should come out and see him tell jokes... DO IT!!!

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: Ben Matlock is in a lousy mood. He took a crowded red-eye flight to Los Angeles, arrived on a foggy morning and, before sunset, he was mugged, drugged, jailed for contempt of court, robbed, accused of murder.

programme.title: Kill For You
programme.desc: Suga, a devoted mother, finds herself opening up to love again when she begins a relationship with Danny, a man who seems genuine and caring. But their connection is quickly tested when she is introduced to Danny’s father, Rusty—a man whose deeply rooted racism creates an undercurrent of tension that can’t be ignored. As Suga tries to navigate the relationship while protecting her son, she begins to sense that something isn’t right beneath the surface.

programme.title: Vanity Flaw
programme.desc: Mallory is a young ambitious woman with dreams of becoming a successful dance choreographer in the industry. Being a risk taker, Mallory decides to dance at a strip club for one night after losing a dare, only to be captured by an obsessive man with a fetish for strippers and violence.

programme.title: What Momma Says
programme.desc: Nearly thirty, Paul Thomas, is still living with his mom. When Paul cannot pay his half of the rent, she kicks him out, forcing Paul to sink or swim when it comes to taking care of himself.

programme.title: Heart of a Woman
programme.desc: Alisha, a rising model with a bright future, chose to put her career on hold to stand by her football star husband Jax. When an opportunity arises for her to return to the runway, their marriage is put to the test, and whether love or career holds the most weight in their relationship.

programme.title: Her Best Revenge
programme.desc: After a tragic death, five fraternity bother reunite at a vacation home, while the shadow of a death from their past lingers over them. A mysterious figure begins to send them threatening messages. Their secrets and loyalties are put to the test and they must uncover the truth about what happened that night five years ago.

programme.title: Born Again Baddie
programme.desc: Following a tragic car accident that claimed her mother’s life and left her father paralyzed, Nia is desperate and forced into a life of crime. After expanding her business and becoming the queen pin of the city, tragedy strikes and it forces her to find solace and reflection on her past life choices.

programme.title: I Hate I Love You
programme.desc: Jacinda and Bradley Wright are Managing Partners of a media company. Over the past year, they have enjoyed unprecedented success, but it comes with a price. From betrayal to illegal activity, both love and business are being destroyed by motives that cause everyone to have an agenda and everyone to have something to gain or lose. The old saying “Keep your Friends close and your enemies closer” are the truest words one can ever speak.

programme.title: The Drive
programme.desc: A doctor is driving home from a conference when he learns his daughter has been kidnapped, and the betrayal comes from those closest to him. With each mile, the certainty that someone within his trusted circle is responsible turns the journey into a spiral of shock and resolve, as the threat to his daughter’s life grows more personal and more urgent.

programme.title: Reality TV Murders
programme.desc: In the world of reality TV, Chasity Safire is a household name and has been the star of the hugely popular reality TV show “Diva’s Doing it” for the past 5 years. When one of the castmates is found dead, the women become suspects and we discover that some of the women would literally kill to be famous.

programme.title: Gimme the Loot
programme.desc: Big Poppa and Ms. Wallace own and operate their own gentleman’s club, “Gimme the Loot” that’s funded by their criminal earnings. Their revenue is partly earned by their exotic dancers they recruit, who double as their crew to execute heists and bank robberies. But when the new crew finds themselves entangled in a high-stakes world of loyalty, secrets, and danger, their loyalties will be tested, and the crew have to decide if “The Loot” is really worth it.

programme.title: If I Can't Have You
programme.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: Baddies Revenge
programme.desc: After discovering her NFL-star boyfriend proposed to another woman live on television, Sierra turns her heartbreak turns into rage. She brings in her closest friends who have suffered betrayals of their own and begin to target the men that destroyed them emotionally.

programme.title: Receipts
programme.desc: Meeko, a high-level drug dealer, has built a thriving operation and a reputation to match. But when his supplier is suddenly killed and his entire network collapses, his supply chain runs dry with no chance of recovery. As a means to pivot, he resorts to a new business venture – blackmail.

programme.title: The Shining Star of Lawrence Hilton-Jacobs
programme.desc: The story of the life and career of one of America’s favorite actors, Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs (Welcome Back Kotter, The Jacksons: An American Dream, Claudine, Cooley High). In fascinating form, Mr. Hilton Jacobs takes us on his life’s journey from his childhood beginning in Harlem, New York to the bright lights of the Broadway Stage and on to becoming a Hollywood movie and television star.

programme.title: Dangerous Affair
programme.desc: Erika and Ryan are a happily married couple living in a high rise Apartment in Atlanta, Ga. everything is going great until Erika meets a handsome, mysterious man in her building and they start having an affair. Once Ryan finds out about the affair Erika ends it. But the mystery man has other plans. Will the married couple survive the Dangerous Affair?

programme.title: Deadly Housewife
programme.desc: Florence is a housewife who yearns for something new and exciting in her love life. Things turn deadly real quick when she doesn’t get what she wants.

programme.title: Covered Silence
programme.desc: Looking for help from a lifetime of trauma, Lala checks in at a mental hospital. There, she meets Niani, and the two form an unbreakable bond of friendship. Once released, Niani learns she is pregnant, and is fearful that her mental illness, and medications will affect the baby. Lala takes it upon herself to protect Niani at all costs. All that changes when Lala's own mental health is jeopardized, when her estranged mother returns in her life.

programme.title: Fall Semester
programme.desc: Kid Kypree is a college student with dreams and ambitions of becoming the next great stand-up comic. One night he gets invited to a party hosted by his old friend Bo that thrusts him into a whirlwind of opportunities and challenges that will test his friendships, resolve, and his sense of humor. He will soon discover that success comes with its own set of comedic twists and turns!

programme.title: Dues Paid
programme.desc: Ava and Jessica are friends who cross paths with a drug dealer who offers them a job to help him legitimize his business after being under investigation. They start to cooperate with him by deterring the police during a murder investigation at the motel that Jessica works at. Lies and secrets are exchanged, and a world of gang related chaos begins to divide a once solid friendship.

programme.title: Grimy Situation
programme.desc: After being arrested at a young age during a drug deal gone wrong and spending part of her youth in prison for the attempted murder of Agent Harris, the now-paroled 30-year-old Camille Sanders has to find a way to make money without turning back to a life of crime and violating her parole. Struggling to survive with no source of income coming in, Camille's forced to live a double life to make ends meet while convincing her Parole Officer she's been

programme.title: In This House
programme.desc: Claudia is a medical student focused on building a perfect life with her live-in boyfriend Dr. Jayson. Her grandfather’s death forces her to go back to her hometown to face her estranged family and her past. Once she arrives, she uncovers sinister secrets and will stop at nothing to break the generational curse stemming from her family’s history.

programme.title: Kingsmen
programme.desc: Follows the story of the King family, a known crime syndicate in Dallas. When the beloved patriarch is killed, they fall under the wrath of a rival crime family, as well as local law enforcement. The four eldest brothers will do everything they can to protect their family.

programme.title: The Loyalty Test
programme.desc: Trey Harrison is an up-and-coming internet star that has created a series exposing cheaters in orchestrated sting operations, successfully turning heartbreak into a viral spectacle. But when two participants are found murdered, Trey’s world begins to crumble and things only begin to escalate.

programme.title: The Groomsman
programme.desc: A co-ed bachelor and bachelorette getaway at a secluded Airbnb spirals into a night of fear and suspicion when Savanna’s former love unexpectedly arrives as a groomsman in her upcoming wedding to Bryce. As tensions rise and unsettling events begin to unfold, it becomes clear that someone is manipulating the group from the shadows.

programme.title: It's Complicated AF
programme.desc: After an intense romance, Ryan and Quaves make the crazy decision to get married without having met in person. But as friends and family gather in Houston for a whirlwind wedding weekend, everything spirals into chaos as the bridal party clashes over secret agendas, bruised egos, and a stolen parking spot. A romantic comedy about fate, bad timing, and the kind of love that refuses to show up quietly.

programme.title: Deadly Surrogate
programme.desc: When a young married couple suffer the pain of infertility, they look to the path of surrogacy and come upon Alana as a potential candidate. As the three become intertwined, tensions begin to unravel and threaten to consume them.

programme.title: Crash Out

Bienvenida va donde Junior y le dice que acepta trabajar en su película. Junior le entrega el guión con unas palabras que hacen llorar a Bienvenida Solymar se porta como novia de Wilker y este no dice nada. Yubiri cree esto y se va para que ellos hablen. Gisela y Juan Diego están de compras y ven a Yubiri.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Tanto Gabriel como Magdalena pelean con su pareja, porque éstos no les creen que la prensa armó una historia sobre ellos, que ellos dicen no es verdadera. Angie no se tranquiliza aún, y llama a un detective para vigilar la situación de cerca. Agustín aprovecha la escena para causarle culpa a Magdalena, mientras él la sigue engañando con Sofía. Luego, Magdalena va a una fiesta, donde tomas algunas fotos, y se encuentra con Ricardo, a quien le da una cachetada por haber escrito ese artículo sobre ella en la revista. Magdalena sale beneficiada por esto, ya que un hombre la felicita y le ofrece un trabajo en el interior del país.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia está fuera de peligro y revela su enfermedad a Ricardo, quien se desespera. Katiuska, furiosa tras ser expulsada de la clínica por Ricardo, ordena a Carrero eliminar a Celia. Mientras tanto, René se aleja definitivamente de Marcelo pese a los intentos de Graciela. Manuela perdona a Ricardo pero no olvida, enfocándose en el bienestar de Celia. Margot inicia una relación con Alejandro, y Marcelo se enfrenta violentamente a Gustavo por el amor de María del Pilar.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rosa busca a Consuelo en la residencia y se enfrentan como madre e hija, pero el dolor del pasado pesa más que el reencuentro y Rosa marcha sin haber perdonado. Blanca llora abrazada a su nieta. Junior recobra el conocimiento y pide ver a Rosa. Erasto descubre con horror que sus piernas no responden y entra en pánico. Arminda celebra disfrutando del castigo. Adolfo enfrenta a Marisela negándose al aborto. Alejandro y Rosalía viven en tensión permanente. Isaías se ofrece a apoyar a Rosa en su pesadilla familiar. Carmen Rosa, ya sin fuerzas, pide perdón a Rosa por todo.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo suspende la boda y Rebeca, enojada, le dice que el padre de Leo es Miguel. Rodrigo finalmente firma su confesión, en la que expone todo el plan de Rebeca. Así que Carlos Ernesto va con la policía a la casa de los Ferrándiz para arrestarla al igual que a Adolfo y Edgar. Pero las cosas se complican cuando Rebeca se fuga. Alejandra sigue sin tener noticias de lo que está pasando y Maribel la va a visitar. Virginia está feliz porque finalmente se sepa quién mató a Miguel. Julio no se toma bien la acusación que Carlos Ernesto le hace a su mamá.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Cristóbal y su primo Guillermo conversan en la plaza, Cristóbal se muestra aún vengativo con Marilda y empeñado en no fallar en su nuevo matrimonio con Ana. Pablo visita a su hija Ana y le cuenta del Fantasma, mientras Ana a él, de Guillermo, su verdadero amor. Venancio vuelve de buscar a su hijo del colegio, en el ascensor se cruza con Pedro, este se pone nervioso y Venancio lo percibe. Carlota recibe a Venancio y su nieto; Venancio expresa sus celos por Lázara. Pedro lo está espiando, nervioso, con sus cámaras, así se entera de que vive en el edificio. Mientras Barranco y Ana conversan, llega su ex, María José, y comienzan a discutir fuerte

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Agustina asesina a su hermana Rebeca para salvar a Irene y a su bebé. Luego los doctores revelan que ella sufría un trastorno de doble personalidad y que creía fervientemente que ella era en realidad su hermana muerta. Tony y Maribel terminan juntos, por comprar una nueva casa para irse a vivir juntos y formar una nueva familia. También Anzola termina casándose con Trinidad en una fiesta de casamiento a la cual toda la familia estuvo invitada. Felipe logra poner tras las rejas a Alejandra y a Rodrigo por los crímenes que cometieron. Antes de llevarlos a la prisión, deja a ella hacer su último descargo con Rodrigo en el que le confiesa que nunca lo perdonará por arruinarle la vida.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Nancy se retira furiosa de la junta de condominio, Pedro logra que Carlos Enrique se quede hablando con Lázara en lugar de ir detrás de su mujer. Patricia deja de estudiar y se va de la casa, harta de las burlas de Carlitos. Al pasar por delante de Pedrote este la intercepta para flirtear con ella y darle celos a Purita. Nancy los ve juntos y se indigna más aún. Cristóbal reserva el salón del condominio para casarse con Ana, ante los ojos de Guillermo. Nancy se queja con Carlitos de lo sucedido en la junta con su padre, pero a Carlitos sólo le interesa enterarse de que Purita quedó sola. Pedro logra que Cristóbal ponga de padrino de bodas al mismísimo Guillermo, generando incomodidad entre él y Ana.

programme.title: Episodio 108
programme.desc: Armando bota definitivamente a Finita de su oficina y de su vida. Por más que ella quiso explicarle | el no aceptó ninguna explicación y la sacó. Briggite anda perdida como siempre. No sabe lo que está haciendo caminando por un pasillo del centro comercial. Pero se encuentra con Yubiri y aprovecha para decirle que regrese a la agencia. Fabián sigue con el ratón. Llega Palma el Productor para darle una gran noticia a Wilker y es que consiguió una presentación en Sábado Sensacional.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Agustín confronta a Gabriel en la calle para dejarle claro que no se vuelva a meter con su mujer. Magdalena descubre en el baño de la casa de Sofía perfume y otras cosas de hombre, por lo que a ella no le queda más remedio que confesar que tiene novio. Magdalena se extraña, ya que siendo su amiga no le contó antes, y Sofía dice que no le contó antes porque el hombre es casado. Luego, Magdalena le cuenta esto a Agustín, y cuando Agustín se encuentra con Sofía se enoja con ella por no poder haber inventado otra excusa. A Gabriel le ofrecen ir a hacer un discurso a Caja Seca, un pueblo cercano, para, entre otras cosas, desviar la atención de los medios por el problema con Magdalena. Gabriel acepta, y Gloria lo acompaña.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo se entera de la verdad y Elizabeth le pide no casarse con Katiuska. Alejandro declara su amor a Manuela. Los médicos informan que a Celia le queda poco tiempo de vida; Katiuska envía a Carrero para eliminarla, pero él huye al ser descubierto. Vincenzo y Tirsa revelan la existencia de un testamento actualizado en Italia. Ricardo, harto de las presiones de Katiuska y su familia por la boda, rompe la lista de invitados y abandona la casa para apoyar a Manuela y Celia.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Junior, ignorando que Rosa es su hermana, le jura amor eterno y le pide casarse cuanto antes. Rosa siente la angustia de no poder decirle la verdad. Erasto queda postrado por parálisis total y Arminda lo cuida con satíricos remedios. Eustoquio celebra el castigo divino y proyecta apoderarse de la fortuna. Adolfo decide contarle a Junior la verdad sobre Rosa pero teme su reacción por su delicado estado. Consuelo ruega a Blanca por consejos. Rosa busca refugio en Isaías. Carmen Rosa fallece en su cama dejando a Rosa huérfana de su único amor materno verdadero.

Erasto queda postrado por parálisis total y Arminda lo cuida con satíricos remedios. Eustoquio celebra el castigo divino y proyecta apoderarse de la fortuna. Adolfo decide contarle a Junior la verdad sobre Rosa pero teme su reacción por su delicado estado. Consuelo ruega a Blanca por consejos. Rosa busca refugio en Isaías. Carmen Rosa fallece en su cama dejando a Rosa huérfana de su único amor materno verdadero.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Agustina asesina a su hermana Rebeca para salvar a Irene y a su bebé. Luego los doctores revelan que ella sufría un trastorno de doble personalidad y que creía fervientemente que ella era en realidad su hermana muerta. Tony y Maribel terminan juntos, por comprar una nueva casa para irse a vivir juntos y formar una nueva familia. También Anzola termina casándose con Trinidad en una fiesta de casamiento a la cual toda la familia estuvo invitada. Felipe logra poner tras las rejas a Alejandra y a Rodrigo por los crímenes que cometieron. Antes de llevarlos a la prisión, deja a ella hacer su último descargo con Rodrigo en el que le confiesa que nunca lo perdonará por arruinarle la vida.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Nancy se retira furiosa de la junta de condominio, Pedro logra que Carlos Enrique se quede hablando con Lázara en lugar de ir detrás de su mujer. Patricia deja de estudiar y se va de la casa, harta de las burlas de Carlitos. Al pasar por delante de Pedrote este la intercepta para flirtear con ella y darle celos a Purita. Nancy los ve juntos y se indigna más aún. Cristóbal reserva el salón del condominio para casarse con Ana, ante los ojos de Guillermo. Nancy se queja con Carlitos de lo sucedido en la junta con su padre, pero a Carlitos sólo le interesa enterarse de que Purita quedó sola. Pedro logra que Cristóbal ponga de padrino de bodas al mismísimo Guillermo, generando incomodidad entre él y Ana.

programme.title: Episodio 108
programme.desc: Armando bota definitivamente a Finita de su oficina y de su vida. Por más que ella quiso explicarle | el no aceptó ninguna explicación y la sacó. Briggite anda perdida como siempre. No sabe lo que está haciendo caminando por un pasillo del centro comercial. Pero se encuentra con Yubiri y aprovecha para decirle que regrese a la agencia. Fabián sigue con el ratón. Llega Palma el Productor para darle una gran noticia a Wilker y es que consiguió una presentación en Sábado Sensacional.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Agustín confronta a Gabriel en la calle para dejarle claro que no se vuelva a meter con su mujer. Magdalena descubre en el baño de la casa de Sofía perfume y otras cosas de hombre, por lo que a ella no le queda más remedio que confesar que tiene novio. Magdalena se extraña, ya que siendo su amiga no le contó antes, y Sofía dice que no le contó antes porque el hombre es casado. Luego, Magdalena le cuenta esto a Agustín, y cuando Agustín se encuentra con Sofía se enoja con ella por no poder haber inventado otra excusa. A Gabriel le ofrecen ir a hacer un discurso a Caja Seca, un pueblo cercano, para, entre otras cosas, desviar la atención de los medios por el problema con Magdalena. Gabriel acepta, y Gloria lo acompaña.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo se entera de la verdad y Elizabeth le pide no casarse con Katiuska. Alejandro declara su amor a Manuela. Los médicos informan que a Celia le queda poco tiempo de vida; Katiuska envía a Carrero para eliminarla, pero él huye al ser descubierto. Vincenzo y Tirsa revelan la existencia de un testamento actualizado en Italia. Ricardo, harto de las presiones de Katiuska y su familia por la boda, rompe la lista de invitados y abandona la casa para apoyar a Manuela y Celia.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Giovanni Talamonti tiene dos hijos Augusto con su esposa y con su amante Luis Francisco y al morir les deja fortuna a cada uno en distintos lugares a Luis Francisco en Italia. Augusto no sabe de la existencia de su medio hermano. Luis Francisco conoce a Clemencia que vivía en un tráiler y hacía poco acababa de morir su padre. Se enamoran y Clemencia queda embarazada pero Luis Francisco lo desconoce y va a Italia en busca de la fortuna que heredó.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.desc: Franco llega al restaurante y Armando queda impresionado, Reyes culpa a Rosario del atentado por perseguirlo. Martín le dice a Norma que Dínora, Gabriela y Fernando quieren separarla de Juan.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes

programme.title: Marido en alquiler
programme.desc: Teresa Cristina le dispara a Fred en medio de un forcejeo. Ro es testigo del asesinato de su amante y se desespera; su lealtad a la Reina del Nilo se tambalea, pero Teresa Cristina lo manipula. Gloria promete guardar el secreto sobre la bebé de Esther.

programme.title: Marido en alquiler
programme.desc: Vanessa emborracha a Reinaldo y se cuela en su cama cuando él se queda dormido. Luego se toma fotos. Reinaldo despierta y se da cuenta que tiene a Vanessa desnuda a su lado. Máximo ve que Carol siente celos de Paloma. Ro llora la muerte de Fred.

programme.title: Marido en alquiler

programme.title: La patrona

programme.title: La patrona
programme.desc: El senador Villegas aconseja sin éxito a su ahijado que no siga con la minera. Alejandro y Gabriela planean irse de San Pedro, y el Tigre los apoya. Mientras, Antonia quiere hacer una prueba de ADN para saber quién es el padre del pequeño David.

programme.title: La patrona
programme.desc: Alejandro empieza a ganar terreno con David. Antonia convence a su hijo mayor de quedarse en San Pedro, se muestra arrepentida y anuncia en las fiestas patronales la futura boda, dejando boquiabiertos a todos. Fernando es internado por su adicción.

programme.title: Road Trip Angler
programme.desc: Jameson Redding hooks up with one of his best friends, Brooks Beatty, to hunt for redfish and sheepshead in beautiful Wrightsville Beach on the coast of North Carolina.

programme.title: Destination Dive
programme.desc: Key Largo is famous for its vibrant coral reefs that teem with life. So, let’s take a dive and explore this amazing underwater oasis that puts Key Largo on the map! This episode also explores the role of Coralpalooza in coral restoration — and an unexpected hero in seagrass protection: tube socks.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.desc: Episode one hits close to home. Specifically, Josh’s hometown of Seattle where we travel from the mountains to the coast in pursuit of local ingredients for an authentic Washington meal. Digging for forest delicacies, hunting for exotic bivalves, and exploring the tidal flats of a multi-generational shellfish farm—it’s all on the menu.

programme.title: Huckberry Homes
programme.desc: "Here at Huckberry, we believe that style isn’t defined solely by what you wear — it’s personified in your morning rituals, your bookshelves and music library, the furniture you choose to spend your waking hours in, and the gear closet that powers your passions and pursuits. Style doesn’t end with your closet, it sparks to life there. - On Huckberry Homes, we’ll be tapping into the most inspiring members of the Huckberry community to offer an inside peek into how they’ve crafted the place they call home. We will showcase everything from cold plunges to vinyl listening rooms, home gyms and offices, and other tools that inspire creativity and high-performing lives. - For our first entry, we turned to Austin, Texas’ own Scott Ballew. Our good buddy, Scott, is a filmmaker and songwriter who owns a Bohemian bungalow in the heart of Austin’s first suburb. It’s a home now that serves as a creative incubator, gathering place, hideaway, recording studio -- and maybe, as a personal shrine of a man curated by the man himself."

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: In the remote Turkish mountains, host Dan Cabela looks at how regulated hunting of ibex has helped protect large areas for wildlife, and funds local conservation initiatives.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle explores the Great Lakes on his Sea-Doo in search of walleye and lake trout.

programme.title: Destination Dive
programme.desc: We will take you to some of the wrecks in the Florida Keys that locals love to dive and share their rich history and the stories held deep aboard these sunken ships. We will also take a deep dive and discuss how these wrecks are critical to the environment.

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.desc: Host Ryan McVinney takes Boat Trader fans on an indepth exploration of Florida flats fishing deep in the backcountry of Islamorada. Featuring Captain Eric Lund, a Wall Street Broker turned backcountry fishing guide, this episode reveals the key design features of the world’s best flats skiffs and how they are built for targeting some of the most exciting sportfish species on the planet. Also, covered are bay boats and their versatility for families exploring Florida’s coastal waterways, along with a detailed study of fish species and wildlife in the region. Some of the area’s most beautiful and secret locales show why Islamorada has earned the nickname of the Sportfish Capital of The World.

programme.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
programme.desc: On this episode of Fox Hollow Outdoors, Michael and Larken end their trip to Florida with an epic day of offshore fishing with Captain Chris Trosset.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: On this episode of Goin' Coastal, Capt. Josh Calhoon brings his store manager Isaiah Lopez with him on a day of inshore fishing for trout and redfish.

programme.title: Canadian Whitetail
programme.desc: A tough slog of a season for Kenny Hayworth as he bowhunts Saskatchewan.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, a special goose hunt in South Dakota becomes a memorable day in the field as Foster heads out with Shadow, his 14-year-old black Lab and longtime hunting partner. With the season bringing challenging conditions and Shadow slowing down with age, the goal is simple: enjoy the hunt and give Shadow one more opportunity to do what he loves. - As the geese begin to move, the hunt delivers an unforgettable series of retrieves and a chance to reflect on the countless hunts and memories the two have shared over the years. From Shadow's early days as a hunting dog to becoming a beloved part of the family, his impact reaches far beyond the field. - With each retrieve, the day becomes less about the harvest and more about celebrating a hunting partner who has given 14 years of loyalty, determination, and unforgettable memories. As Foster looks toward future hunts without Shadow by his side, one thing remains certain—the memories they made in the field will never be forgotten.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Over a decade after the game changing Longbeard XR was introduced by Winchester, the wait is finally over for their next ground breaking turkey load. After years of perfecting the recipe behind the scenes, Winchester finally unveiled the new Longbeard TSS at a turkey camp in northern Michigan. First watch the jaw dropping Longbeard TSS pattern board testing, then see it go to work on some spring gobblers.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Nestled in the hills of Ohio just west of the Appalachians is a very special deer camp ripe with memories from deer season’s past. With the development of the 350 Legend straight-walled cartridge by Winchester in 2019, a world of opportunities now existed in states like Ohio and Michigan. In this episode, with the 350 Legend in hand, three mature whitetails meet their maker, from the same blind, over the course of three seasons.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: It’s been 60 years since AA was introduced to the shooting sports world. Since that day, an immeasurable number of AA hulls have hit the ground and countless shooters have stood center stage raising a trophy where millions of dollars have been won. Professional and recreational shooters alike have trusted AA for six decades. In this episode, load up for stories of high school, collegiate competitors and the world’s best as they bust clays with the legendary shot shell. - GUESTS: Zach Keenbaum (Team Winchester) Desi Edmunds (Team Winchester) Kayla Wilgus (Team Winchester) Amy Cawley (Team Winchester) Anthony Matarese (Team Winchester)

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff join a local biologist searching for a white rhino whose tracking collar has failed, leaving it exposed to poachers. As they follow its trail through the African bush, the search builds toward a heart-pounding encounter that none of them will ever forget.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle takes to the water in a way few anglers dare, fishing from a Sea-Doo in search of the ancient lake sturgeon, a species that’s been around since the age of the dinosaurs and can live over 100 years. Hooking into one of North America’s largest freshwater fish from a personal watercraft proves to be a challenge unlike any other.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff embark on a 20-day mission into the Everglades to find the invasive pythons that are plaguing the ecosystem. These apex predators have eliminated more than 90% of fur-bearing animals in their new home. Can they turn the tide, or is the Everglades already lost?

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff get bit by catfish in Southern Oklahoma with YouTuber Nate Williams of Adrenaline Rush Adventures while using the most primitive fishing tactic - hand fishing. Learn from the Chickasaw Nation about the history of this method that has been used by Native Americans for thousands of years.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: It is Mark Peterson’s third day in Mexico hunting for a Mexican Texanus Whitetail. After bagging two big bucks in just two days with his new Gunwerks Nexus 300 PRC, he is now moving to a new farm where a giant 12-point buck has often been seen in the southeast corner of the property. It’s the coldest day since he arrived, which typically means the deer will be more active. He is thrilled at the prospect of what could be the best day yet. If everything goes well, they will spend the evening - hunting hogs from the high rack.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark is wrapping up his Argentina hunt and heading to Entre Rios to track down the final two birds on his list: the Rock Pigeon and the Eared Dove. This area is home to over 10 million birds, making it a prime hunting ground. With flocks of pigeons and doves filling the skies, Mark is set for a fast-paced, action-packed finish to his hunt—a perfect end to an unforgettable adventure.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Join Mark Peterson as he heads to Kentucky for the late muzzleloader season. Already having an unforgettable season so far after taking “Freak Show” back in early September, he is looking to cap off his Kentucky season with a great buck with his Muzzleloader.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson is in the final stretch of completing the South America Upland Slam. Having already checked off nine species in Argentina, he now finds himself in Peru, where he faces the challenge of tracking down two elusive species to complete his list: the Andean Tinamou and the Western Peruvian Dove.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson continues his journey toward the North America Deer Slam — this time deep in the rugged mountains of North Central Mexico. In pursuit of one of the smallest and rarest Whitetail subspecies, the elusive Mexican Central Plateau Whitetail, Mark faces harsh terrain, high elevations, and the challenge of locating a deer that few hunters have ever seen, let alone taken.

programme.title: Bearded Buck
programme.desc: We are back in Pennsylvania for the start of archery season as Austin continues his 2 year quest for a buck we call Elliot. This buck has been a resident on the farm for at least 3 years now but every archery season he seems to turn into a ghost. After hunting him all of last year with no luck, Austin is hoping that this is the year that it will all finally come together.

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.desc: On this episode, we travel to OHIO for some legendary Lake Erie Walleye Fishing. We hook up with Veteran owned businesses “Five-O-Fishing Charters” and “Team Recon Fishing Systems” as they guide us how to fish Lake Erie. We also highlight both of these owners and the service and sacrifice that has led them to where they are today!

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.desc: On this adventure, we travel west to central South Dakota for a Deer hunt of a lifetime!! Military and Law Enforcement Veteran David Huntimer is able to join along as we spot and stalk whitetails and mule deer across the prairie and coulee landscape. Guiding us on the trip is AHO Ambassador John Pikop and Volunteer fire fighter Dustin Aske. We even get a surprise fire call on this outing!! We also highlight our next SCHEELS hometown hero, Mike Hawkins!

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: An Honor No One Wants: A Gold Star Family is the immediate family member(s) of a fallen soldier who died while serving in a time of conflict. Sheila Mitchell-Murphy honors the memory her Son…American hero Etienne Murphy.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: 82 year old Navy veteran with more than 2.7 million TikTok followers, Patriotic Kenny talks of how he helps other vets through him gifting mobility scooters to fellow veterans in need.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Kasey Morgan of HuntWorX is back in the Show-Me State, self-filming an early season whitetail hunt with one goal in mind, catching up to a mature Missouri 10-point. Banking on a rising moon, predictable feeding patterns, and fresh trail camera intel, Kasey slips into a ridge-top food plot where a giant buck has recently been showing daylight.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Kansas is known for producing world-class whitetails, and Colten Scroggins of The Fever Crew head to the Sunflower State to hunt with our good friends at Triple H Outfitters. After drawing an early season youth rifle tag, Colten has one goal in mind, tagging a true Kansas giant.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Every great hunting property has a buck that becomes part of its history. In 2017, that buck was "Forky" for Pat Reeve of Driven Hunter. Just days before Minnesota's archery opener, Forky began regularly visiting a strategically placed waterhole, giving Pat the confidence that opening weekend could be something special. With months of preparation leading up to the season, everything came down to being in the right tree at the right time.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Three years of patience came down to one perfect evening. Alex Rahman with Prime Ridge Outdoors has watched a buck he calls “Lopsided Larry” for the past three seasons, patiently waiting and giving the deer time to reach his full potential. Heading into 2025, the wait was finally over, and Larry became Alex’s #1 target for the season.

programme.title: Super Retriever Series 2026 Crown Championship
programme.desc: Super Retriever Series Presented by Purina Pro Plan Returns to Shreveport-Bossier for the 2026 Crown Championship

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: Hunter Bach takes Blair to the northern part of the Indian River to catch redfish.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: Capt. Blair heads out of Cape Canaveral with an old friend Capt. Scott Lum looking for triple tail and Cobia.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Every great hunting property has a buck that becomes part of its history. In 2017, that buck was "Forky" for Pat Reeve of Driven Hunter. Just days before Minnesota's archery opener, Forky began regularly visiting a strategically placed waterhole, giving Pat the confidence that opening weekend could be something special. With months of preparation leading up to the season, everything came down to being in the right tree at the right time.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. From visiting Vineyards and sampling wine, to helicopter hunts for Himalayan Tahr, this episode is everything that is a hunters dream. As well as harvesting the wild game New Zealand has to offer Andy also learns about the importance of the conservation efforts that hunting has in this country from locals in which he spends time with.
Adam and Logan Hays chase big bucks in the Buckeye State!

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: The West Texas desert has a way of pulling you in. In Desert Ghost, Will Cooper heads west to Marathon, Texas, with longtime friend and mentor Cody Roberts to hunt aoudad in one of the most remote landscapes in the state. Rooted in family legacy, this film explores Cody’s deep ties to the desert, the story behind Desert Ghost Distillery, and the mystique of a western oasis near Big Bend National Park. More than a hunt, Desert Ghost dives into the role of aoudad management and its importance to desert bighorn sheep conservation efforts led by Texas Parks and Wildlife and the Wild Sheep Foundation. Sometimes, to protect what belongs here — you have to chase the ghosts. You really do have to be tough, determined, or one lucky bastard to make it out in West Texas.
Follow Adam Hays as he hunts for his 5th 200 Inch deer in his home state of Ohio.

programme.title: Stoked On Fishing
programme.desc: This past summer (2019), we met a new friend Jason, the CEO of the Catalina Island medical center in the city of Avalon. Jason mentioned that he was in charge of a campaign for the Catalina Island Medical Center Foundation. This campaign aims to raise money to build Catalina Island, a much-needed, state-of-the-art medical center. Jason asked us if we could be one of the big-ticket auction items from the list. We would provide a three-night stay on the stoked on a fishing yacht, two days of fishing on our Stoked On Fishing Charters 35-foot everglades, and provide fantastic food and drinks when we arrived back in Avalon. We love Catalina, and the idea of creating a hospital for the future of the Island was a no-brainer. We couldn't let this great opportunity go to waste and had epic two days of fishing in San Clemente Island with some new friends.

programme.title: Remote Lakes, Big Fish, Epic Days
programme.desc: Paul and Perry kick off an adventurous journey down the Ivanhoe River, heading toward a lake that’s known to deliver steady walleye action. But this time, the fish had other plans. With walleye proving tough to track down, the duo turns to the river’s reliable residents—Northern Pike—to keep the rods bending and the spirits high. Surrounded by stunning scenery, flowing rapids, and beautiful waterfalls, this river run becomes more than just a fishing trip—it’s a reminder that the North’s wild beauty always makes the day worthwhile, no matter what’s biting.
